UserVoicePreferences.title: UserVoicePreferences
UserVoicePreferences.description: Stores a signed-in user's Google account metadata, saved favorite voices, plan tier, daily AI usage counter, and referral credits.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

plan.description: User access tier. Always initialized as free; only admin can promote to pro.

proPackageType.description: Optional active Voice Studio Pro subscription cycle set by admin.

proExpiresAt.description: Optional expiration timestamp for monthly/yearly Pro subscription.

dailyCount.description: Number of AI generations used on lastUsageDate.

lastUsageDate.description: UTC date string (YYYY-MM-DD) for dailyCount reset.

referralCode.description: Unique uppercase alphanumeric referral code for this user.

bonusCredits.description: Referral bonus AI credits earned (+10 per referred friend). Never self-increasable by owner.

referralCount.description: Total number of friends successfully referred by this user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the user document was last updated.

ReferralCodeMap.title: ReferralCodeMap
ReferralCodeMap.description: Public non-PII mapping from a short referral code to the owning user's UID.

uid.description: Owner UID of this referral code.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when code was registered.

ReferralClaim.title: ReferralClaim
ReferralClaim.description: One-time immutable record created when a referred user claims a friend's referral code, granting +10 credits atomically to the referrer.

referredUid.description: UID of the user who signed up via referral (matches document ID).

referrerUid.description: UID of the referring user who receives +10 bonusCredits.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when referral was claimed.

ProUpgradeRequest.title: ProUpgradeRequest
ProUpgradeRequest.description: Stores user payment submission details requesting Pro unlock approval from the admin.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the requesting user.

userEmail.description: Verified Google email of the requesting user.

userName.description: Display name of the requesting user.

packageType.description: Requested Voice Studio Pro package duration (monthly or yearly).

paymentMethod.description: Payment method used to pay the Pro unlock fee.

senderNumber.description: Sender mobile number or account reference.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when request was submitted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when request was last updated.

BillingConfig.title: BillingConfig
BillingConfig.description: Admin-configured Pro unlock pricing, payment instructions, and free daily quota limit.

feeAmount.description: Display price for Pro unlock (e.g. 50 BDT).

monthlyFee.description: Display price for Voice Studio Monthly Pro package (e.g. 50 BDT).

yearlyFee.description: Display price for Voice Studio Yearly Pro package (e.g. 480 BDT).

paymentAccount.description: Account/mobile number to send payment to.

freeDailyLimit.description: Daily free generation limit per user (1-100).

apiBaseUrl.description: Optional dynamic backend API base URL (e.g. Render/Node server URL) for static hosts like GitHub Pages.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when billing config was last updated.

SalonConfig.title: SalonConfig
SalonConfig.description: Admin-configurable prices, booking fee, and schedule settings for Jagannath gents parlour and salon.

currencySymbol.description: Currency symbol or code shown alongside prices (e.g. BDT or ৳).

beardTrimPrice.description: Price for Beard Trim & Styling service.

hairColorPrice.description: Price for Hair Color & Wash service.

bookingFee.description: Slot booking fee added to service price.

isBookingOpen.description: Whether online appointment booking is currently accepting requests.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when salon config was last updated.

SalonBooking.title: SalonBooking
SalonBooking.description: Appointment booking created by signed-in users for Jagannath gents parlour and salon.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the customer.

servicePrice.description: Service price at time of booking.

bookingFee.description: Booking fee at time of booking.

couponCode.description: Optional one-time AI coupon code redeemed on this booking.

discountPercent.description: Percentage discount applied from the AI coupon (10-30).

discountAmount.description: Exact discount amount deducted from servicePrice.

status.description: Appointment status managed by admin (or cancelled by owner while pending).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when booking was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when booking was last updated.

AppIssue.title: AppIssue
AppIssue.description: Internal application error or system warning logged silently for Admin-only review in the Admin Notification Box.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the signed-in user who experienced the issue.

reporterEmail.description: Email of the user who encountered the issue.

reporterName.description: Display name of the user who encountered the issue.

source.description: Module or component where the issue originated.

severity.description: Severity level of the app issue.

details.description: Optional technical details or stack/host metadata.

status.description: Notification resolution status controlled by Admin.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when issue was recorded.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when issue status was last updated.

SalonCoupon.title: SalonCoupon
SalonCoupon.description: One-time AI-generated discount coupon issued once per verified Gmail user for Jagannath gents parlour and salon.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the verified user (matches document ID).

userEmail.description: Verified Google email of the coupon holder.

userName.description: Display name of the coupon holder.

discountPercent.description: Percentage discount off salon service price (10-30).

status.description: Coupon usage state. Can transition once from available to used.

usedBookingId.description: Document ID of the salonBooking where this coupon was redeemed.

usedAt.description: Server timestamp when coupon was redeemed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when coupon was generated.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when coupon was last updated.

AdminFeedbackThread.title: AdminFeedbackThread
AdminFeedbackThread.description: Direct feedback conversation thread between a customer (from Voice Studio or Salon page) and the Admin.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the customer.

pageScope.description: Which app section the feedback thread belongs to.

lastMessage.description: Preview snippet of the latest message.

lastSenderRole.description: Role of the sender who sent the latest message.

unreadByAdmin.description: Whether Admin has unread replies in this thread.

unreadByUser.description: Whether the customer has unread Admin replies.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when thread was last active.

AdminFeedbackMessage.title: AdminFeedbackMessage
AdminFeedbackMessage.description: Individual message inside an AdminFeedbackThread between a customer and Admin.

threadOwnerUid.description: Owner UID of the parent thread for secure list filtering without get().

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the message author.

senderRole.description: Whether the message was sent by a user or Admin.

pageScope.description: App page context for this message.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was sent.

CommunityMessage.title: CommunityMessage
CommunityMessage.description: Public user-to-user opinion message inside the shared Community Chat rooms (non-PII).

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the message author.

senderName.description: Public display name of the sender (no email or phone).

originPage.description: Page where the user wrote the opinion.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was posted.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user document storing Google info, favorites, plan tier, daily AI usage, and referral bonusCredits.

/referralCodes/{code}.description: Non-PII lookup table mapping a referral code to its owner UID.

/referrals/{referredUid}.description: One-time referral claim record preventing self-referral or duplicate claims.

/proRequests/{requestId}.description: Pro upgrade payment verification requests submitted by users and approved/rejected by admin.

/appConfig/{configId}.description: Public Pro unlock fee & payment instructions readable by signed-in users, editable only by admin.

/salonConfig/{configId}.description: Live service prices, booking fee, and schedule configuration for Jagannath gents parlour and salon.

/salonBookings/{bookingId}.description: Salon appointment bookings submitted by users and managed by admin.

/appIssues/{issueId}.description: Admin-only issue notification log written silently on app/API errors and readable/manageable exclusively by admin.

/salonCoupons/{userId}.description: Single lifetime AI-generated salon coupon per verified Gmail user, atomically marked used on booking.

/adminFeedbackThreads/{threadId}.description: Direct feedback conversation threads between customers of Voice Studio / Salon pages and Admin.

/adminFeedbackThreads/{threadId}/message.description: Messages inside each direct customer-to-admin feedback thread.

/communityMessages/{messageId}.description: Public user-to-user chat messages across General, Voice Studio, and Salon discussion rooms.
